name: Fire Bolt
blurb: Cantrip. Hits one spot and lights anything flammable there. Hold the cast and it spreads to the squares round the spot.

name: Burning Hands
blurb: Level 1. A 15 ft cone of flame from your hands: everything that can burn in it catches. Hold the cast and it reaches further.

name: Fireball
blurb: Level 3. A bead of flame that bursts where it lands, 25 ft across, setting it all alight. It goes off with a bang: things near it are thrown back, it blows a small crater in the ground and scatters burning debris a few cells out, and it sets off oil, dust and gas. Our blast is smaller than the SRD's 20 ft radius and hits for 3d6, not 8d6, since it also sets everything in it burning; the Big fireball mod gives you the radius. Hold the cast for a wider blast that throws things harder.

name: Meteor
blurb: Level 7. A burning rock falls from the sky where you point and bursts in a ring of fire 45 ft across, throwing everything back and blasting a deep crater. Our own single-stone reading of the SRD's Meteor Swarm (level 9, four of them). Hold the cast for a wider ring of fire and a harder blast.

name: Ray of Frost
blurb: Cantrip. A 25 ft beam from you toward where you click. Freezes water into walkable ice and snuffs fire. RAW it only chills a creature; the ice is our physical reading. Hold the cast and the beam reaches further.

name: Shocking Grasp
blurb: Cantrip. Lightning travels through water and metal that touch the spot. Hold the cast and it arcs into the squares round the spot.

name: Gust of Wind
blurb: A 60 ft line of wind from you toward where you click. Pushes light things, blows out small flames, fans big ones, drives windmills. Hold the cast and it reaches further and pushes harder.

name: Grease
blurb: A slick 10 ft square. Things slide across it. Flammable here, as in BG3; check the SRD text before relying on that. Hold the cast for a bigger slick.

name: Create Water
blurb: Pours water that flows downhill, fills pits and boilers, douses fire, soaks fuel so it burns poorly, waters burnt ground so green shoots come up through the ash, and soaks creatures. Hold the cast for more water over a wider patch.

name: Sleet Storm
blurb: Level 3. Freezing sleet over a wide circle where you point: ponds and puddles freeze into walkable ice, flames go out, and the dry ground glazes with frost that creatures slide on until it thaws. RAW it also breaks concentration. Hold the cast for a wider storm.

name: Flood
blurb: Combo (water, then water). A wave from you toward where you point, 30 ft long: it slams into whatever stands in it, knocks raiders back (off a cliff, if there is one), shoves light things along and fills the low cells it runs over. Our own spell. Hold the cast and it runs further.

name: Geyser
fizzle: The geyser fizzles: there's no water there to boil
blurb: Water and fire together: aimed at a pond or river, it boils the water where you point into a roaring jet, 15 ft across, that throws whatever floats or stands in it up into the air and scalds whoever swims there. It acts only on water already there: on dry ground it fizzles. Our own spell. Hold the cast for a wider jet.

name: Wave
blurb: Water and water together: a wave 15 ft wide rolls out from you toward where you point, 40 ft over the ground. It puts out fires on the way, soaks and knocks back the creatures it meets and carries light things along, leaving shallow water behind it, then breaks and leaves mud where it stops. Our own spell. Hold the cast and it runs further and wider.

name: Frost
blurb: Water and air together: a 40 ft blast of freezing air from you toward where you point. Water freezes into ice you can walk on (an ice bridge over a river), wet creatures freeze solid so the next hit shatters them, flames go out, and dry ground glazes with frost that is slippery underfoot until it thaws. Our own spell. Hold the cast and it reaches further.

name: Mud
blurb: Combo (water, then earth). Churns the soil and grass where you point to mud, 15 ft across: it slows whatever walks it and smothers fire, and dries back to dirt in time. Our own spell. Hold the cast for a wider patch.

name: Forge
blurb: Earth and fire together: the heat of a forge on the ground or thing where you point, and the material decides. Sand fuses into glass, mud bakes into brick, metal glows red hot, ice and snow melt, wet things dry. It lights nothing.

name: Molten Boulder
blurb: Combo (earth, then fire). A glowing boulder hurled where you point: it bursts in fire 15 ft across, throws things back, and leaves a pool of lava where it struck. Our own spell. Hold the cast for a wider burst.

name: Dust Storm
blurb: Combo (earth, then air). A cloud of dust 25 ft across where you point: its grit stings, whatever is caught in it stumbles blind for 3 seconds, and it's thick enough to hide what's behind it; it drifts with the wind and settles away. Our own spell. Hold the cast for a bigger cloud.

name: Thunderwave
blurb: A wave of force all around you. Throws everything next to you away from you, even a boulder, a little. Hold the cast for a wider wave that throws harder.

name: Misty Step
blurb: Blink up to 60 ft (twice the SRD's 30 ft, so it reaches across the yard) to a square you can see. Bars and gates don't block sight; walls do. Hold the cast to blink further: half as far again, or twice as far held to the full.

name: Levitate
blurb: One thing floats for a while, you included. It ignores pits and slick ground, and the lightest gust carries it. Hold the cast and it floats higher and stays up longer.

name: Mage Hand
blurb: Pick up something light (tap it), then set it down within 30 ft (tap the spot). Hold the cast and the hand reaches further and lifts heavier things.

name: Lower Earth
blurb: Cantrip. Digs a 10 ft patch down a step, or more the longer you hold the cast, stripping grass and anything spilled on it. Water runs in. Soft ground only: rock needs Stone Shape or a pick. Our reading of Mold Earth.

name: Raise Earth
blurb: Cantrip. Heaps a 10 ft patch up a step, or more the longer you hold the cast: held to the full it rises three steps, a mound as tall as a wall. Water on it spills off. Our reading of Mold Earth.

name: Earthen Trench
blurb: Gouges a 40 ft channel two steps deep from your feet toward where you click. Cut it from a pond and the water follows. Hold the cast for a longer, deeper channel. Our reading of earth shaping; not an SRD spell.

name: Wall of Stone
blurb: A 30 ft wall of rock rises from where you click, running away from you, wall-high even across a trench; hold the cast for a taller wall. Blocks walking, sight, gas and water; dams a stream. Over water it rises only a step, as stepping stones. Rock is hard: only Stone Shape, a pick or a Falling Star breaks it back down to rubble.

name: Stone Ramp
blurb: Wall of Stone held to full charge: a ramp of rock rises from where you point, a step higher each cell away from you up to two, so you can walk up it onto a ledge. Hold the cast for a higher ramp.

name: Rolling Boulder
blurb: Earth and air together: a boulder rolls out from you toward where you point, up to 50 ft, and follows the ground downhill. It knocks creatures over, smashes what is brittle (glass, ice; the first knock cracks it), and leaves a trail of dust a spark sets off. In water it stops and dams the stream; elsewhere it comes to rest as a boulder. Our own spell. Hold the cast and it rolls further.

name: Move Earth
blurb: The ground heaves up into a hill 35 ft across, highest in the middle. Hold the cast for a higher hill. Water runs off it and pools around the foot.

name: Hasten Time
blurb: Level 3. For half a minute the day runs twenty times as fast for everyone: the sun races across the sky and about ten hours go by, so dusk or dawn comes. Hold the cast and it runs longer (fifteen hours, then twenty). Cast it again while it runs and time settles back to its own pace. Our own spell, in the spirit of the SRD's time magic.

name: Control Weather
blurb: Level 8. You turn the weather for everyone, a step each cast: clear, then rain, then snow, then a storm, then clear again. It holds for two minutes (hold the cast for three, or four), then the natural weather comes back. The SRD's spell takes 10 minutes to set in and lasts 8 hours; ours ramps in over half a minute.

name: Fog Cloud
blurb: Level 1. Thick fog fills a 20 ft radius where you point. Nothing sees through it (Misty Step can't blink past it), it drifts with the wind, a Gust of Wind blows it away, fire burns it off, and it thins out over a minute or so.

name: Plant Growth
blurb: Level 3. Life floods back into burnt land 45 ft across, and vines climb the walls and bridge the pits and streams in it (walkable, and fuel for a fire; when they die they rot, and their roots crack the stone walls they held): the ash clears, green shoots spread out from the middle and are grass again in a few seconds, and saplings rise from old stumps and grow into trees. Hold the cast to reach further and seed saplings in the ash too; held all the way, young trees sprout in the meadow as well. Our reading: the SRD's spell overgrows or enriches plants; here it heals what fire took.

name: Spike Growth
blurb: Level 2. The ground 40 ft across bristles with hard thorns for a minute: anything walking through is slowed to half speed and cut with every step (1d4 a square; the SRD's 2d4 would kill a wizard in three steps). Thorns burn, leaving ash. Hold the cast to spread them wider.

name: Shapeshift
blurb: Aim at an animal within 60 ft and take its shape for a minute (hold the cast for two or three): its speed, its size, and its own kind's trust. Cast again to change back. No spells and no hands while you're an animal, and a heavy blow knocks you back into yourself. Our reading of Polymorph, cast on yourself.

name: Acid Splash
blurb: Cantrip. A bubble of acid bursts where you point, 15 ft across, and eats away what acid can: brambles, thorns, spilt oil and grease. It burns any creature in the splash. RAW each creature makes a Dex save, and the damage grows with your level; here it is always 1d6. Hold the cast for a wider splash.

name: Scalding Steam
blurb: Fire and water together: a burst of thick steam, 25 ft across, where you point. It scalds anything of flesh standing in it, rusts metal it hangs over faster than water alone, drifts with the wind, and rains back down as water once it has drifted away from any heat.

name: Lava Pool
blurb: Fire and earth together: the ground where you point melts into a 15 ft pool of lava. It runs downhill a cell at a time, leaving a crust of rock you can walk on, burns whatever stands on it, sets into rock at once where it meets water (with a burst of steam), and cools into rock after a while.

name: Falling Star
blurb: Fire and air together: a glowing mark shows where a small star will land a second later, so aim ahead. It blows a shallow crater with a little lava in it, scatters burning rock around it, melts the snow and ice it hits and flashes water to steam.

name: Flame Wave
blurb: Fire and air together: a 20 ft cone of flame driven by a gust behind it. Everything that can burn in it catches, and the wind it raises carries the fire on and drives smoke and steam downwind.

name: Lightning Bolt
blurb: Level 3. A stroke of lightning from you toward where you point. With metal or water within 30 ft it jumps to the nearest instead and runs all through it (charge a puddle to reach a coil and power the gate); with none it flies 100 ft straight. It arcs through water and metal it touches, sets what can burn smouldering, fuses sand into glass, and hits every creature in the line.

name: Rain Cloud
blurb: Air and water together: a low rain cloud, 25 ft across, where you point. It rains on the cells under it for a while, wetting them, putting fires out, slowly filling holes and bringing burnt ground back to green, and drifts with the wind (a Gust steers it) until it thins away. Lightning into it makes a storm cloud that keeps striking; cold turns it to a snow cloud.

name: Sand Blast
blurb: Air and earth together: a 40 ft line of scouring sand from you toward where you point. It stings whatever it hits, scours off what lies on the ground (snow, frost, ash, vines), scours rust off metal, wears a log wall thin and then through, wears raised earth down a step, and leaves the ground it crosses covered in sand (which lightning fuses and Forge bakes into glass).

name: Whirlwind

carries.name: waterspout
carries.log: The whirlwind sucks up water into a waterspout

carries.name: fire tornado
carries.log: The whirlwind catches and roars into a fire tornado

carries.name: sandstorm
carries.log: The whirlwind whips the sand into a sandstorm

carries.name: snow flurry
carries.log: The whirlwind whitens into a snow flurry

carries.name: smoke column
carries.log: The whirlwind darkens into a column of smoke

blurb: Air and air together: a whirling column of wind 25 ft across where you point, for ten seconds. It wanders with the wind, or on the way you cast it, and takes on what it crosses: a fire tornado over fire, a waterspout over water, a sandstorm over sand, a smoke column, a snow flurry. It spreads what it carries and drops the lot when it dies out. It draws smoke, fog and steam in toward its middle and drags small creatures and loose things in with them, blows small flames out and fans big ones in toward the eye, and fire caught in it races round the ring.

name: Tornado

carries.name: waterspout
carries.log: The whirlwind sucks up water into a waterspout

carries.name: fire tornado
carries.log: The whirlwind catches and roars into a fire tornado

carries.name: sandstorm
carries.log: The whirlwind whips the sand into a sandstorm

carries.name: snow flurry
carries.log: The whirlwind whitens into a snow flurry

carries.name: smoke column
carries.log: The whirlwind darkens into a column of smoke

blurb: Air and air thrown together: Whirlwind grown huge, a roaring funnel 35 ft across where you point, for half a minute. It wanders with the wind, or on the way you cast it, and takes on what it crosses as a whirlwind does: a waterspout over the lake, a fire tornado over burning ground, a sandstorm, a smoke column, a snow flurry. Whatever stands in its eye 25 ft across is lifted off its feet, whirled round and flung 50 ft out the way you cast it, hurt by the fall (more off a cliff). Our own spell, after the SRD's Whirlwind. Hold the cast for a wider funnel.

name: Thunder Strike
blurb: Fire and air thrust together: the sky marks where you point, and half a second later a column of lightning 35 ft across comes down on it with a clap of thunder. Everything in it is struck, wet creatures twice as hard. It charges a rain cloud into a storm, arcs through water and metal that touch it, fuses sand into glass, shatters ice, and the clap scatters smoke, steam, fog and dust. Our own spell. Hold the cast for a wider column.

name: Earth Spires
blurb: Earth and earth thrown together: a jagged line of earth pillars bursts up from in front of you toward where you point, 60 ft long. A creature where a spire comes up is thrown into the air, hurt and off its feet for two seconds; everywhere else a pillar stands, cover that raiders must batter down and walls in what tries to pass. Another earth spell breaks them back to rubble. It fills pits and channels it crosses. Our own spell. Hold the cast for a longer line.

name: Iceberg
blurb: Water and water thrown together: where you point, a mass of ice 25 ft wide heaves up out of the water, or out of the pool it makes on dry ground, and crashes on away from you, 40 ft. It crushes what it rolls over, soaks it and freezes it (a frozen creature cracks at the next hit and shatters at the one after), and freezes the water it rolls through and lays into ice you can walk on: an ice bridge across the lake. Fire melts that ice back into a flood. Our own spell. Hold the cast and it rolls further and wider.

name: Light
blurb: Cantrip. Touch something and it sheds bright light in a 20 ft radius and dim light for 20 ft more, for an hour.

name: Stone Shape
blurb: Level 4. You work a cell of stone like clay: raised rock where you point gives way a step, broken into rubble. Rock is too hard for the lesser earth spells; metal and bedrock never give way.
